title: EEO Officer / EEO Manager assignment history
summary: Versioned history of RTEC EEO Manager/Officer assignments assembled from policy statements, AAP plans, Title VI plans, organization charts and handbook evidence.

claims.claim: The March 2023 handbook names Sheila Stallsworth as EEO Manager/EEO Officer reporting directly to the Executive Director.
The AAP plan updated through June 30, 2024 names Tracy Champion as EEO Administrative Manager and EEO Officer, reporting within the Executive Director/Board accountability structure.

evidence.page_or_section: Responsibility for Affirmative Action Plan Administration / EEO Policy Statement
evidence.note: Evidence establishes the named role holder in the plan updated through 2024; it does not establish the exact start date of the assignment.

claims.claim: The 2026 organization chart revised 2025-12-30 names Clarissa Hodge as HR & EEO Manager, providing an early-2026 organizational snapshot between the 2023 handbook assignment and the later 2026 signed EEO statement.

evidence.note: Early-2026 organization-chart snapshot; later 2026 signed EEO policy names a different EEO Officer.

claims.claim: The Title VI/LEP plan approved by the Board on January 19, 2026 names Clarissa Hodge as Title VI Coordinator/EEO Manager, corroborating the early-2026 organization-chart assignment.

evidence.page_or_section: Title VI Statement of Policy / Coordinator Contact Information

claims.claim: The signed 2026-08-26 EEO policy statement names Jacob Salsman as EEO Manager/EEO Officer, reporting directly to the Executive Director with authority across levels of management and employees.

evidence.note: Later dated assignment supersedes the 2023 officer assignment for current role-holder purposes.

controls: Treat named role holders as effective-dated evidence rather than timeless profile facts.
Direct reporting to the Executive Director is explicit in the 2023 handbook and 2026 signed EEO policy.
unresolved_questions: What exact date did EEO responsibility transition from the AAP-era Tracy Champion assignment to Clarissa Hodge?
What exact date did the early-2026 Clarissa Hodge EEO assignment transition to the EEO Officer named in the signed 2026-08-26 policy?
Did HR Manager, EEO Officer and Title VI Coordinator responsibilities remain combined or split during each transition?
automation_candidates: Maintain role-holder history separately from durable EEO role responsibilities so personnel changes do not overwrite the policy model.

provenance.notes: Names Tracy Champion as EEO Administrative Manager/EEO Officer in the plan updated through June 2024.

provenance.page_or_section: Title VI Statement of Policy / Coordinator information
provenance.notes: Early-2026 EEO/Title VI role evidence; later August 2026 EEO policy supersedes current role-holder purposes.
